name: Gasthof Fuchsanger
beschreibung: The Gasthof Fuchsanger is situated in the municipality of Rettenschöss in the Tyrolean Unterland. The property offers simple yet practical guest rooms equipped with en-suite shower and toilet. The traditional dining parlour and outdoor terrace serve as welcoming common areas for guests to relax. The surrounding landscape is characterised by rolling farmlands and lush forests. Scenic hiking trails and ski areas are within easy reach. The atmosphere of the inn is shaped by its peaceful rural surroundings. The kitchen prioritises regional produce and time-honoured culinary recipes.
